subject: Implement Crucible snapshot features
description:
Phase 5 of Crucible integration: Snapshot management.

Tasks:
1. Implement snapshot ioctl handlers in drivers/crucible-blk.cc
2. Implement Rust snapshot methods in CrucibleDevice:
   - snapshot() - create snapshot
   - list_snapshots() - list all snapshots
   - rollback() - restore to snapshot
3. Integrate with CLI tool (crucible-admin)
4. Test snapshot functionality:
   - Create snapshot
   - Write data
   - Rollback
   - Verify data restored

Prerequisites:
- Task 10 complete (CLI tools ready)

Timeline: 1-2 weeks
